title.zh-Hans: 小晶晶历险记之品鉴瓯越美食
title.en: The Adventures of Little Crystal: Taste the Ouyue Cuisine

description.zh-Hans: 《瓯越美食大冒险》是一款基于 Dora-SSR 游戏引擎 开发的物理弹射类休闲游戏，融合了温州地方文化特色与经典愤怒小鸟玩法。玩家将扮演贪吃鬼晶晶的朋友，帮助他品尝各种正宗的瓯越美食！
description.en: 'Ouyue Food Adventure' is a casual physics-based slingshot game developed with the Dora-SSR game engine. It combines the local culture of Wenzhou with classic Angry Birds gameplay. Players take on the role of Little Crystal's friend, helping him taste a variety of authentic Ouyue delicacies!
